Established in 1988, the Firm has extensive knowledge and experience developing solutions tailored to meet the exacting needs of a diverse and global client base of institutional and private wealth investors. Capital Dynamics oversees more than USD 14 billion in assets under management and advisement and employs approximately 150 professionals globally across 14 offices in Europe, North America, and Asia. Capital Dynamics is a recognized industry leader in responsible investment, receiving top marks (Five Stars) from PRI across all categories and investment strategies, as well as in GRESB benchmarking for its clean energy strategy. Technology At Capital Dynamics Our Technology department is responsible for the development, secure operation, maintenance and support of Capital Dynamics' global IT infrastructure and solutions — enabling employees to communicate, collaborate and automate routine tasks, while ensuring information security and compliance with company policy and relevant regulation. The Opportunity We're looking for a highly capable graduate to join our Technology department as Technology Analyst in New York — the primary technology contact for our New York office, and a genuinely hands-on role from the outset. Reporting to the CTO, you'll take real ownership of the stability and quality of our Microsoft 365 environment, end-user support across every business function, and the operational backbone of our core IT processes: provisioning, asset management, and break-fix resolution. This is a designated development position: as your core competencies are established, you'll gain structured exposure to Capital Dynamics' data and AI programme — putting you at the centre of some of the most interesting technical work happening at the firm. Real Ownership, From Day One This isn't a narrow, ticket-queue support seat. End-to-end ownership of user lifecycle management — provisioning, deprovisioning and access rights — for all New York-based staff. Direct contribution to the firm's live SharePoint infrastructure, as part of our broader data programme. Real autonomy to manage competing priorities without close supervision — and real visibility, since your work directly supports investment professionals and senior management. Tamr — the machine learning-driven master data management and entity resolution platform underpinning the firm's data warehouse. Organised and self-directed, with the ability to manage competing priorities without close supervision. A mindset suited to a real development pathway — curious, capability-driven, and ready to grow into more advanced data and AI work over time.
